hero.title: Assignments, Attendance, and Progress — All in One Place.
hero.subtext: Submit assignments, track grades, and see contribution ranking. The official portal for IT Club at SMK Negeri 1 Surabaya.

platform.title: One Portal. Every Club Need.
platform.lead: From assignment submission to attendance recaps, everything runs in one place. Members know what to do, board members know who has submitted.

items.title: Member Dashboard
items.desc: Active assignments, points, and ranking on a single screen.

items.title: Assignment Submission
items.desc: Upload a file or paste a link, with deadlines always in view.

items.title: Meeting Attendance
items.desc: Attendance per session, recapped without re-checking lists.

items.title: Recap & Ranking
items.desc: Points are computed from on-time submissions and attendance.

items.title: Notifications
items.desc: New assignments and approaching deadlines land in your inbox.

items.title: Announcements & Gallery
items.desc: Official board news and activity documentation, visible publicly.

features.title: Relax, Every Assignment Is Handled.
features.lead: The four things that usually cause friction in a club, solved from day one.

items.title: Assignment Submission
items.subtitle: Upload file & link, clear deadlines
items.desc: Submit tasks via file or link. Deadlines are always visible, so nothing gets missed without you realizing.

items.title: Grading & Feedback
items.subtitle: Scores and notes from the board
items.desc: Board members give scores with notes. You know exactly what fell short and how to improve it.

items.title: Meeting Attendance
items.subtitle: Check in for every session
items.desc: Every meeting is logged cleanly. Attendance history is ready whenever it is needed.

items.title: Member Ranking
items.subtitle: Points from timeliness and attendance
items.desc: Ranking is computed from on-time submissions and attendance, updated automatically.

testimonials.title: Collaboration gets clear when everyone knows what to do.
testimonials.lead: IT Club members on how the way they work changed since this portal went live.

items.name: Rani Putri
items.quote: One place for every assignment. No more chasing people over chat, and nothing slips through.

items.name: Dimas Prasetyo
items.quote: Deadlines are visible from the start, so the team can plan weekly without guesswork.

items.name: Ayu Lestari
items.quote: Grades and notes arrive right away. I know exactly what to improve next.

integrations.title: The tools you already use, all connected.
integrations.lead: Link GitHub, Figma, and Google Drive so submissions no longer scatter across places.

footer.title: Start with the first assignment.
footer.lead: Enter your email to get early access to the IT Club portal.
